component.name: WaySwitch Settings
component.summary: Control the native WaySwitch keyboard correction service

description.p: Configure Russian and English keyboard layout correction, gestures, exceptions, pause and resume the native WaySwitch service, and check for updates.

This package contains the settings window only. Install the native WaySwitch package separately on the host. The native service requires explicit keyboard and uinput access. This settings window communicates with the service and does not read keyboard devices.
The first-run window explains native installation and recovery. Removing this window does not remove or stop the native correction service.
